name: inspira-hyper-text
blurb: Text unscrambles letter-by-letter from random symbols.
description: Characters start hidden and resolve to the actual text progressively. Triggers on scroll into view or hover, with configurable duration and character set.
use_when: Section headlines or CTAs that benefit from an entrance effect without layout shift.
avoid_when: Long passages or accessibility-critical labels — animation duration makes content unavailable briefly.
a11y: Content is hidden during animation; focus/keyboard cannot access it until reveal completes.
